Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed seeking leave to appeal against the impugned order dated 24th April,
2023 passed by the Ld. MM-03, South West District.
Dwarka Courts, Delhi in Complaint Case No.4994793/2016 acquitting the accused-respondent in proceedings under section 420/468 IPC.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that despite the evidence before the Court, the Ld. Trial Court has acquitted the respondent.
2. On petitioner taking steps, notice be issued to the respondent through all permissible modes including whatsapp, SMS and email, returnable before this Court on 11th September, 2023.
3. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 22, 2023/sm
